Subject: Redwood trial — procurement and next steps

Hi Samir / Lisa,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the trial --> paid path:

1) Procurement preference: do you want to pay via PO or corporate card? If PO, please confirm the billing contact and where to send the SOW/invoice.
2) Marketplace interest: are you interested in procuring via Azure Marketplace (we can enable meter/bill via marketplace) or do you prefer direct contract?
3) Success criteria: you mentioned a couple of evaluation signals (latency, cost per inference, hit rate for prefix caching). Can you confirm the concrete success threshold(s) we should track during the trial? Example: 100k generated tokens / 25k embeddings over 30 days, and <200ms p50 on representative endpoints.
4) Billing start: our usual approach is to start billing when either the agreed usage threshold is met or after the 30-day trial ends, whichever comes first — open to align on your preference.

Attached a quick SOW draft and an example trial usage report template for your team to review. Aditya will follow up on technical measurement details.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Samir/Lisa: confirm PO vs card and procurement contact by end of week (6/26)
- We'll send an editable SOW and invoice flow doc (attached)
- Aditya to share the usage report cadence and how we measure tokens/embeddings

Thanks — I'll keep the calendar open for a follow-up next week if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Technical note — measuring trial usage and reports

Hi all,

Quick technical follow-up on how we measure the trial thresholds Marissa outlined so procurement and engineering are aligned:

- Tokens: we report generated tokens per model endpoint (counts include prompts + generated tokens). Our usage report (attached) provides daily and rolling-7 metrics; we'll share a spreadsheet view weekly.
- Embeddings: we report number of embedding vectors created and total embedding units.
- Latency: we provide p50/p90/p99 for representative endpoints; for SLAs we use p50 as an actionable signal during evaluation.

I'll run the first automated usage report tomorrow morning and add a column that maps to the 100k/25k thresholds so you can see progress toward billing start.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

2) PO timeline: Acme expects to submit the PO by 2026-07-10. Please send the PO to procurement@acme.com and cc me.

4) Marketplace: we will keep Azure Marketplace as a future option; initial procurement will be direct invoicing.
5) Reporting cadence: Aditya will send weekly usage reports; I will also share a summarized progress update each Friday until conversion.

- Send SOW v1.1 with clause and DocuSign link (Marissa)
- Send W-9 and payment instructions inside SOW (Marissa)

If that aligns, I'll open the DocuSign and lock in the legal/w-9 + payment instructions. Appreciate the collaboration — keen to get you live.
